faq.question: Why did the 1905 partition matter?
faq.answer: It reorganized Bengal administratively and triggered mass protest, boycott politics, and new arguments about representation.

faq.question: Was the response uniform?
faq.answer: No. Swadeshi opposition, Muslim political support for Eastern Bengal, and later communal-national arguments developed in different directions.

faq.question: Why include 1906 and 1911?
faq.answer: The founding of the Muslim League in Dhaka and the annulment of partition are direct political consequences of the 1905 decision.
